verifiedCodeFindings: Each transaction walks all rows and structured-clones the complete request once for every row.
Each refresh clones and lays out the entire resolved document on the browser main thread.
measureText tries remaining paragraph prefixes repeatedly at successive line boundaries; the native runtime serializes each shape result.
Rendering rebuilds decorations and composition mirror across all document lines rather than the affected viewport.
queueMicrotask and async wrappers do not isolate synchronous WASM work from input/rendering.
boundary: Read-only runtime investigation in a separate headless browser. No Core or Editor behavior repair in this review. Architecture proposals are not implementation evidence.
priorEvidence: 224-character live-input checks remain bounded observations; they do not establish long-input readiness.
